summary: - **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)**: `DelphesEDM4HepConverter` keeps energy, mass and momentum consistent by assigning the pion mass to every track that is not an electron or muon. It also sets the PDG ID for tracks and leptons, so analysts no longer need to infer particle identity from the mass. Converted outputs change slightly, and a new test catches lepton charge mistakes.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)**: Fixes `GenfitTrackFitter` correctness issues: Wrong units in the helix-to-Cartesian Jacobian and in the z0 conversion. A singular initial z0 covariance for seeds close to the reference point. Broken hit–track associations introduced during filtering. Track states are now built with GENFIT-native extrapolation, using the first and last digitized hits for `AtFirstHit` and `AtLastHit`. The `AtIP` state is documented as not meaningful for displaced tracks.

- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489)**: Removes the deprecated `inputReader` Python module, which relied on the now-removed `PodioInput`. Users must switch to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers`.

- **[key4hep/DDML#19](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/19)**: Adds a `ddml` Python module that provides `ddml_physics`, `add_shower_model` and pre-built `ModelConfig`s for the included models. It replaces the sprawling flag-driven `ddsim_steer.py` logic and gives downstream ddsim steering files a streamlined way to set up ML fast-shower simulation.

- **[key4hep/DDML#16](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/16)**: Inference models are initialized before the event loop instead of lazily, and geometry is initialized late enough for DD4hep settings to be available. The default changes to non-hadron showers, which alters behaviour for configurations that relied on the previous default.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433)**: Fixes boolean properties on the `k4run` command line, which previously could never be switched off because `bool("False")` evaluates to `True`. Booleans now accept True/False, true/false and 1/0 and reject anything else, and a bare flag means True.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#70](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/70)**: Adds `TrackerHit3D` conversion to the Gaudi KalTest track machinery so it matches the Marlin behaviour (fixes k4GaudiPandora#58). FTD composite spacepoints remain unhandled.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)**: Adds the IDEA option 2 (`IDEA_o2_v01`) digitization and reconstruction configuration, based on the reduced geometry, with a CTest. It incorporates the recent IDEA_o1 tracking updates and requires k4RecCalorimeter#271.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#400](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/400)**: Adds the EvtGen decay card `Lb2L1520NuNu.dec` for Λb⁰ → Λ(1520)⁰ νν̄ with Λ(1520)⁰ → pK⁻, plus the charge-conjugate chain, for FCC-ee flavour studies.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#561](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/561)**: Changes how HTCondor log and output files are handled with pre-EDM4hep-1 stacks. HTCondor warnings about log-file placement no longer trigger up to 10 spurious resubmission retries.

- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-drs#106](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs/pull/106)**: Adds a Detector(s) field to dataset requests, accepting comma-separated values such as IDEA, ALLEGRO or ALFA. The field is mandatory, enforced client- and server-side, whenever the Final Processing Stage is anything other than generation, and it is included in notification emails.

- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf#16](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/16)**: Conversion depth becomes a CLI argument instead of a config property, which enables full-depth conversions. The remaining config properties are renamed and updated config files are provided, so existing custom configs need updating.
